thread:
mia: Quick sync re: Verdandi onprem outage postmortem — want to lock owners and closure dates for the remaining remediation items. TL;DR: VPC peering flaps were due to MTU mismatch + config drift on their edge, and an on-prem kernel bug that drops fragmented packets. :spiral_note_pad:

raj: Sounds good. Can you paste the current outstanding action list?

mia: Copied from the postmortem doc, condensed: 
- A1: Fix VPC MTU mismatch on Verdandi's transit routers (owner: raj) — target: 1 week
- A2: Harden peering auto-reconnect logic in our dedicated agent (owner: sylvia) — target: 2 weeks
- A3: Add KV cache healthcheck and fallback (owner: angelo) — target: 3 days
- A4: On-prem kernel workaround + recommended firmware upgrade for Verdandi (owner: devon, coord with Verdandi SRE) — target: 2 weeks
- A5: Post-deploy traffic validation test for peering (owner: samira) — target: 4 days

sylvia: I can take A2 but want to split into: A2a (circuit backoff) and A2b (better logging). A2a can be 1 week, A2b 2 weeks.

angelo: A3 is small; I'll ship a toggleable healthcheck and a fallback path. Will need a tiny config flag for Dedicated customers.

devon: For A4 I chatted with Verdandi's SRE — they need a safe rollback plan if firmware upgrade regresses. I'll propose a canary plan and a rollback playbook.

samira: I'll build the post-deploy test as a CI job that exercises a 10-minute peering churn and validates KV sync across regions. Will need test creds from Verdandi.

mia: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) Everyone paste their exact PR branch names into this thread once created. 2) Put a short test plan line in the PR description referencing the postmortem tests.

raj: Starting A1 tomorrow. PR branch: fix/verdandi-mtu-2026. Test plan in PR will include raw pcap verification and MTU probe matrix.

remediation-bot: A reminder: the postmortem has 5 open actions. Owners assigned. Next follow-up due in 7 days. See https://redwood.internal/postmortems/verdandi-onprem for details.

mia: Small nit — the KV healthcheck must be opt-in for Dedicated customers until we can confirm no perf regression. Angelo, add a config flag and default to off.

angelo: Yep — branch ded/kv-health-fallback. Flag: "kv_health_fallback_enabled" (false by default).

sylvia: Branch: infra/peering-backoff-verdandi. I'll open A2a first and then follow with A2b.

devon: Branch: ops/verdandi-fw-canary. Proposal doc uploaded to the Verdandi customer workspace.

samira: Branch: test/verdandi-peering-churn. I'll ping Verdandi SRE for creds after this sync.

mia: Risk notes: A4 is highest risk (firmware). Make sure we have packet captures from before and after. Also, the kernel bug that drops fragments only triggered at high concurrent flows — include load profile in the test.

raj: Roger. I'll attach a small script in the PR: 
```
# mtu probe
for size in 1400 1500 9000; do ping -M do -s $size ${VERDANDI_EDGE}; done
```

sylvia: Also adding a quick log marker when we trigger peering-backoff so SRE can grep. Format: peering_backoff=verdandi reason=mtu_probe_fail

mia: Can we set a mid-point check-in in 3 days to see which items are blocked? I'll run the sync.

remediation-bot: Calendar reminder: "Verdandi remediate mid-check" scheduled in 3 days.

angelo: FYI I expect A3 done in 48hrs. If anyone wants to test earlier I can deploy a canary to a single Dedicated pool.

devon: I'll coordinate Verdandi's firmware window for next Tue/Wed. That's in 6 days; aligns with the 1-week target for A4.

samira: I'll try to get test creds today. If Verdandi delays, I can run a synthetic test against a staging mirror.

mia: Great. Final ask before I close out this thread: drop the estimated ETA in the PR and add a label "postmortem-remediation/verdandi". I'll track in the postmortem doc and escalate if any slip. :white_check_mark:

raj: Done — PR opened and label set. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4781

sylvia: PR opened for A2a: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4782. Marked as draft until logging is added.

angelo: PR draft at https://git.redwood/platform/pulls/1490 — will mark ready after internal canary.

devon: Uploaded canary playbook and PR: https://git.redwood/ops/pulls/2033. Verdandi confirmed tentative window.

samira: PR: https://git.redwood/tests/pulls/512. Waiting on creds.

mia: Thanks team. I'll re-open this thread for the 3-day checkpoint and post an agenda. If anything blocks you before then, ping #eng-oncall and @mia directly.

raj: Thanks.

sylvia: Thanks.

angelo: +1

devon: +1

samira: +1

remediation-bot: Thread closed for now. Follow-up reminder will trigger in 72 hours.
